WHY IT EXISTS: the #1809 fixture (aoe_splash_target_filter.json) pins target_filter 1 (TF_NOT_TEAM),
read from the MobTemplate on 2026-08-01. The CDN blob PUBLISHED ON 2026-08-04 carries target_filter 0
(TF_NONE) for the same row. That divergence is the whole reopened defect: the sim resolver is faithful,
the data one of its readers is fed is not. Re-capture this file (pointer -> payload -> path) on any
republish; never edit a field by hand.
THE CHAIN DISAGREES WITH THE BLOB — this is NOT an authoring choice. Re-read 2026-08-06 through
https://graphql.testnet.sui.io/graphql, object 0x150ab689eb9d4f7a5c0ada910b73bd3cf9849e1b0ba7b16b1f99ccf87b9f95ae:
chain spells[0] 'Devastating Slam'  kind 0, area_shape 1, area_size 2, target_filter 1, 36..54
chain spells[2] 'Savage Strike'     kind 0, area_shape 0, area_size 0, target_filter 1, 22..36
The chain is CORRECT. The blob is not: ALL 1030 mob-spell effects in world_corpus.20260804a carry
target_filter 0 — a uniform constant across every mob in the game, which is the signature of a
projection that never writes the field, not of 1030 authoring decisions. 9 of the 14 published AoE
effects are damage, and all 9 lost their filter, so every one of those casters splashes itself.
CONSEQUENCE: the world fight path reads the chain and is fine; the SIMULATOR page reads this blob and
is not. #1809's seal drove both twins (sim + Move) clean and was honest — the blob is a THIRD reader
that was never in the twin. The fix belongs to the content pipeline's world_corpus emitter.
GEOMETRY (cell = y*20 + x, GRID_W 20) — the reported cast: the boss aims at a player ONE cell away, so
its own radius-2 circle swallows its own cell. Shared with fixtures/aoe_splash_target_filter.json so the
two rows differ in exactly ONE variable: the filter.
